# S3.9 — the protocol edges (R-2.5.4⁰): `import_listing`/`refresh` for `mcp_listing`, `sync_source`/deltas/`freeze`/`unavailable`/`adopt`, the dual-era probe-first MCP stdio client + stateless server, `ProtocolBinding`, the E5 battery, the `attribution_completeness` veto, helper-overhead distributions, and the minimal profiles' `edit_file` shapes (R-2.5.2⁰/R-2.5.3 S3 slices)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5d.4 · §5d.2/§5d.3 (S3 slices)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/055_S3.9__tool-protocol-edges.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.5.4⁰, R-2.5.2⁰, R-2.5.3 (S3 slice)**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s3.8` (stacked) · **Stage:** 3 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all checks hermetic)
**ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0286-s3.9-protocol-edge-rulings.md`

## Summary

**The MCP edge is real I/O.** `hh-mcp` gains `protocol.rs`
(`ProtocolBinding`, `Era`, the pinned version set `{2026-07-28,
2025-06-18}`, `ProtocolVersionMismatch`/`RequiredExtensionUnsupported`/
`PeerUnreachable`), `client.rs` (the dual-era, probe-first stdio client:
`server/discover` probed before any other request, compatibility-probe
fallback into the legacy era, bounded paginated `tools/list`,
`call_tool` → `ToolOutcome{observed | paused(input_required) | failed |
protocol_error | unknown}`) and `listing.rs` (`import_listing`/`refresh`
producing the pinned `SurfaceDocument` + `LiftReport` + the
`surface_name → (server_ref, semantic_id)` map). The stateless server
carries `supportedVersions`, `ttlMs`/`cacheScope`/`resultType`,
`resultType: "input_required"` with an opaque `requestState` echo,
`notifications/tools/list_changed` on bundle change, and a `--legacy`
era mode. Every row in `hh-mcp/tests/s3_9.rs` runs against the spawned
`hh-mcp-serve` binary (AC-R-2.5.4-11).

**Imports are quarantined, refresh is honest.** `hh-registry::import`
registers lifted declarations `admission = quarantined` /
`authority = unverified` with `unknown_domain` honesty effects —
absent from every exposure plan until `seal` (AC-R-2.5.1-12). Foreign
hints ride `source.declared_claims` verbatim and are never read for a
decision (a foreign `readOnlyHint` on a writing tool keeps the worst
risk class and stays `ask` under default Π — AC-R-2.5.4-3). `refresh`
mints `supersedes{edit}` versions, classifies description-vs-schema
change, reports `capability_changed_under_run`, and never transfers a
`pin` over `listing_hash` (AC-R-2.5.1-6). Own-export import recovers
the carried `_meta` set with the exact declared-loss report
`{cost_model.measured_ref, execution_requirement, exposure_hint}`
(AC-R-2.5.1-5).

**Catalog sync is one path.** `hh-compiler::exposure::sync_source`
drives all six `SyncTrigger`s through `listing → CatalogEntry[] →
catalog_delta → adopt`; `freeze` keeps `catalog_id` and marks removed
entries `unavailable("removed")`; `adopt` opens a new epoch stamping
imported surfaces `authority = unverified`. The E5 battery proves every
`SurfaceFailure` class renders pairwise-distinguishably under each
minimal profile; the E6 static check refuses a result renderer that
drops a validator-read field; and the minimal profiles' `edit_file`
maps (`patch` under `parse(grammar_ref)`, `string_replace` under
`project`) are total and sound with E4 green on both
(AC-R-2.5.1-4, AC-R-2.5.2-6/-7).

**`lift∘lower ∪ loss_report = x`.** Both minimal profiles round-trip
through the MCP artefact: every runtime-plan tool is recovered or named
in the loss report, and `permission.enforcement`/`budgets`/`validators`
are declared `no_slot` — never silently dropped (AC-R-2.5.4-1). Two
independent clients receive byte-identical `tools/list` in canonical
order with freshness members; a second bundle changes the bytes and
fires `listChanged` (AC-R-2.5.4-2). The spec-DAG check finds no edge
from any HIR entity, ledger class or component contract to a protocol
schema (AC-R-2.5.4-8); unknown `_meta` and `_`-prefixed kinds survive
`lift∘lower` in `ext` (AC-R-2.5.4-9).

**The veto reads both attribution surfaces.** `attribution_completeness`
folds `model.call.attempt.completed` × `measurement.cost.attributed`
coverage *and* the `action.effect.unattributed` signal marker (which
survives the `ledger_facts/1` round trip — a reloaded run still trips).
Tripped ids land on `EvalRun::veto_tripped`; a vetoed success is
excluded from the headline cell and counted beside it — never clean,
never a bare zero. `0/0` is `n/a`.

**`action.tool.surface_rejected` fires at both detection sites**
(ADR-0286 D4). Dispatch arg-eval failures (`unmapped_argument`,
`domain_violation`) emit the §5d.2 row with the full payload and no
`Effect`; parser-detected spellings shared by the two closed sums
(`unparseable`, `unknown_surface`) dual-emit `control.output.rejected`
(the §5e.2 format-failure accounting) **and** `action.tool.surface_rejected`
(the action-plane span terminal). §5e.2-only classes keep the control
row alone — no spelling is re-mapped.

**Helper overhead is a distribution.** `action.tool.completed` carries
`{execution_ms, executor_class, isolation_class}`;
`harness_overhead.execution_ms` is registered and folds to per-stratum
distributions with typed `n/a` on empty strata.
